lines: それにしても、全く……結局このような事態になろうとは。[p]
Still and all... to think it should come to this in the end.[p]
嘆かわしい。[p]
A lamentable thing.[p]
こんにちは。[p]
Good afternoon.[p]
ご無沙汰しています。[p]
It has been a long while.[p]
あの一件以来でしょうか。[p]
Not since that business, I think.[p]
おお、よく来たね。[p]
Ah, good of you to come.[p]
彼が帰ってしまう前に挨拶をしようと思って。[p]
I thought I would say goodbye before he goes.[p]
そうか……。[p]
I see...[p]
辛いだろう。[p]
It must be hard.[p]
身が裂けるような思いです。[p]
It feels as though I'm being torn in two.[p]
こんなことになるなんて、想像もしていなかった。[p]
I never imagined it would come to this.[p]
すまない、一緒に居られなくて。[p]
I am sorry I cannot stay with you.[p]
両親には何があっても残ると言ったのだが……。[p]
I told my parents I would stay no matter what, but...[p]
寂しいけど、仕方ないわよ。[p]
I shall miss you, but it cannot be helped.[p]
あなたが残ったらきっと大変な目に遭うわ。[p]
If you stayed, you would surely come to harm.[p]
そんな簡単に割り切れない。[p]
I can't simply accept that.[p]
やっぱり、私だけでも……。[p]
Perhaps I alone should remain...[p]
ありがとう、その気持ちだけで嬉しい。[p]
Thank you. Just knowing you feel that way means a great deal to me.[p]
大丈夫よ、いつまでも殺伐とした状態になるわけじゃない。[p]
It will be all right. This bitterness will not last forever.[p]
そうだな。[p]
You are right.[p]
私らもいる。[p]
And we are here as well.[p]
君も妹さん共々、絶対に元気でいるんだぞ。[p]
You and your sister — take care of yourselves, no matter what.[p]
勿論です。[p]
Of course.[p]
そうだ、これを預かっていただきたいんです。[p]
Ah, yes. I should like you to keep this for me.[p]
おお、これは……。[p]
Oh — this is...[p]
なになに？[p]
What is it, what is it?[p]
私に何かあった時の為の保険だ。[p]
A safeguard, in case anything happens to me.[p]
もし、困ったことになったら、ここへ来れば大丈夫だ。[p]
If ever you find yourself in trouble, come here and you will be all right.[p]
そんな不吉なこと言わないで！[p]
Don't say things like that![p]
必ず……帰ってきて。[p]
You have to come back... promise me.[p]
Yes...![p]
何があっても必ず。[p]
No matter what happens.[p]
必ずまた再会しよう。[p]
We will meet again. I promise.[p]
この殺伐とした空気が消えたその時に……。[p]
When this bitter air has cleared at last...[p]
